sources.prices: U.S. Energy Information Administration, daily spot prices (RBRTE, RWTC)
sources.volatility: Computed from EIA daily spot prices (spikes.py)
sources.weekly: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Weekly Petroleum Status Report; five-year range per METHODS.md section 1
sources.curve: U.S. Energy Information Administration, NYMEX WTI futures contracts 1 and 4 (RCLC1, RCLC4), ends April 5, 2024
sources.cot: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Commitments of Traders (legacy and disaggregated), WTI 067651
sources.usd: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED, Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index (DTWEXBGS)
sources.ust10y: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED, 10-year Treasury yield (DGS10)
sources.retail: U.S. Energy Information Administration, weekly US retail gasoline and diesel prices
sources.shipping: IMF PortWatch, daily tanker transits, 7-day average
sources.flows: U.S. Energy Information Administration, international data and US crude imports by origin
